title: ShoppingListAisleGrouper
description: Add `CookbookApp/ShoppingLists/ShoppingListAisleGrouper.swift` — a view-layer helper that iterates `ShoppingList.text` once. Each `^## <name>$` line opens a new named bucket; each `ShoppingListItem` is assigned to the most recent bucket. Items before the first `## heading` go into a leading bucket with `name == nil`. Returns `[(name: String?, items: [ShoppingListItem])]`. Does not modify `text` and has no CookbookCore dependency beyond the existing `ShoppingList` and `ShoppingListItem` types.
acceptance_criteria: Items before any `## heading` land in the nil-named bucket
Items after `## produce` land in a bucket named "produce"
A second `## dairy` heading switches subsequent items into a new "dairy" bucket
Multiple consecutive `## heading` lines with no items between them are tolerated (empty intermediate buckets)
Pure function: same input always produces same output

handoff_summary.completed: Implemented `ShoppingListAisleGrouper` as a caseless enum with a static `group(_:)` method. Iterates `shoppingList.text` once via `components(separatedBy:"\n")`. On each `## <name>` line the current bucket is flushed and a new named bucket opened; checklist lines matching the same regex pattern as `ShoppingList.itemRegex` are parsed into `ShoppingListItem` values and appended to the active bucket. The leading nil-named bucket captures items before any heading. Empty intermediate buckets are preserved naturally. Text is never mutated. Build succeeded on iOS Simulator target.
handoff_summary.remaining: None — all acceptance criteria are met.
handoff_summary.risks: The `try!` NSRegularExpression initialization mirrors the pattern used in `ShoppingList.swift` (same regex string). If the pattern were ever invalid it would crash at launch, but this is a compile-time-constant literal so the risk is negligible.
handoff_summary.next_action: Tester agent should verify the grouper against the acceptance criteria scenarios (nil bucket, named buckets, consecutive headings with no items, no text mutation).
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: None. New file, no modifications to existing files.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used a caseless enum as namespace (consistent with `AisleIconMap`). Single-pass iteration to honour the spec's "iterates text once" wording. Duplicated the item regex pattern from `ShoppingList` (private, not re-exportable) rather than adding a round-trip through `shoppingList.items` which would require a second scan for heading positions.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No tests written (developer scope). Tester agent should cover: empty text, no headings, items before first heading, named buckets, consecutive headings without items, case-sensitive heading names, checked and unchecked items.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: The regex is duplicated from `ShoppingList`'s private `itemRegex`. If `ShoppingList` ever changes its item syntax, `ShoppingListAisleGrouper` must be updated separately.

conflict_risks: None. New file, no modifications to existing files.
